svg.title: streamline moderne gig poster
svg.desc: Pale Light Promotions presents: / CARVER & THE FLOOD / with support from Mena Grace / Friday 19th September, doors 7:30pm / The Anchor Rooms, 14 Tallow Lane, Bristol WX4 2JQ / Tickets: £12 advance / £15 on the door / Available from The Anchor Rooms bar or pallightpro.co.uk / All ages. Bar until midnight.
svg.text: AVAILABLE FROM THE ANCHOR ROOMS BAR OR PALLIGHTPRO.CO.UK
THE ANCHOR ROOMS, 14 TALLOW LANE, BRISTOL WX4 2JQ

g.data-flaw: The red rule under the headline is nicked where THE was blanked, and a dark smudge is left by the microphone below FLOOD; the support line and date are the original's pixels.
g.data-outlook: Fixable: blanking should repaint a rule or gradient along its direction rather than from the pixels around it.
